learned: 2026-10-17: jeeter.com/ny-lab-results is a Webflow page of ~250 NY report PDFs on Webflow's CDN (separate /az-lab-results for Arizona).
notes: Filenames are <webflow id>_<FORMAT> DFNY-<STRAIN6>-<MMDDYY>.pdf, sometimes prefixed 'Amended'. FORMAT: Baby (Baby Jeeter), XL, 1G, HG.
The strain is a ~6-letter code (PINCOL, BLUZKZ, APPBAN); strain_code resolves it, else the report's product line names it.
lines: Baby -> Baby Jeeter, XL -> Jeeter XL; 1G and HG reports take their category from the report's sample type.
